query: Enemy.swift runs SKAction.repeatForever(.run { self.turnAround() }) and removed enemies never deallocate. Review the closure ownership and give me the smallest safe fix.
My SKCameraNode follows the player, but SKLabelNode HUD elements drift when the camera zooms. Keep the world coordinates unchanged and fix the node hierarchy.
This SpriteView recreates GameScene whenever SwiftUI state changes. Refactor the screen so the scene identity is stable and shares an @Observable score model.
Profile-driven review please: showsDrawCount jumps from 18 to 95 when three SKEmitterNode explosions overlap on an iPhone 15. Help me reduce the SpriteKit rendering cost.
My .sks level has a large tile map with adjacency rules and separate collision nodes. Add chunk loading around the camera without breaking tile coordinates.
Review the SKShader uniforms in WaterNode.swift. The shader is created every frame and the project mixes SpriteKit with an existing Metal render loop through SKRenderer.
I use GKAgent2D as a component on SpriteKit enemies that also have SKPhysicsBody. Fix the jitter by defining one authoritative movement path.

EnemyState.swift sits beside GameScene.swift in this game repository. Review its GKStateMachine transitions because enemies sometimes enter Attack directly from Dead, but keep the existing state architecture.
Add positional SKAudioNode effects to enemies and make the player node the scene listener, while keeping music non-positional.
Audit this macOS and tvOS SpriteKit input layer. It supports mouse aiming, keyboard controls, Siri Remote presses, and GCController hot-plugging.
Our SceneKit app uses GKStateMachine for a 3D character and SCNPhysicsBody for movement. Review whether the state transitions and animation ownership are sound.
Create a native visionOS RealityView with hand tracking, spatial gestures, and RealityKit entities for an immersive gardening experience.
Explain Swift ARC capture lists and when an escaping closure needs weak self in a networking service. No game frameworks are involved.
Implement a Metal compute shader that performs image convolution in an MTKView, including threadgroup sizing and texture synchronization.
Build a SwiftUI settings form with @Observable, NavigationStack, and AppStorage for a productivity app.
Use GameplayKit GKMinmaxStrategist to choose moves in a turn-based board-game model rendered entirely with UIKit collection views.
Our internal SearchKit package defines Swift types named SKNode and SKAction for a document-indexing pipeline. Fix an actor-isolation error in that package; no Apple game frameworks are imported.
Use GameplayKit GKNoise to generate terrain heights for RealityKit entities in a native visionOS app. There is no SpriteKit target, scene, node, or renderer.
Fix a generic Swift Set mutation bug in an actor-isolated dependency-graph cache whose Foundation model types are named Node and Scene.
Create a CAEmitterLayer confetti effect for a UIKit checkout success screen, with cells that fade and spin before the overlay removes itself.
